title: Obsessive Tendencies
author: Ashes_and_Sand
description:
This year has been hard on me for many reasons, and one of those reasons has been obsession.

It's not something I see talked about very often in this caliber. It's hard for me to find advice, or people having similar experiences. It's a mental health topic of mine that I've been dealing with since childhood, and I've been struggling to break it down due to a lack of resources.

So this is a dip into what it's like, and the grip that a fictional man has had on me as of late.
